name: METAL
description: METAL is a multilingual meta-evaluation benchmark designed to assess the performance of LLM-based evaluators in summarization tasks across 10 languages using native speaker judgments. It aims to evaluate the alignment and bias of LLM-based evaluators compared to human judgments.
reputation: A niche but useful multilingual meta-evaluation benchmark for assessing LLM-based evaluators in summarization, cited in work on evaluator bias and human alignment.
notes: Focuses on evaluating LLM-based evaluators rather than LLMs themselves; covers 10 languages; uses native speaker judgments for summarization.
